caseName: New England Power Co. v. New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: New England Power Co. v. New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission Massachusetts v. New Hampshire Legislative Utility Consumers' Council and Roberts, Attorney General of Rhode Island v. New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. N. H. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 451 U. S. 981.] Motion of New Hampshire Legislative Utility Consumers’ Council to withdraw as a party appel-lee in Nos. 80-1208, 80-1471, and 80-1610 granted. Motion of New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission and the State of New Hampshire to dismiss the New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission as a party appellee in Nos. 80-1208 and 80-1610 granted. Motion of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts for substitution of New Hampshire Public Utilities Commission as a party appellee in No. 80-1471 denied. It is ordered that the State of New Hampshire be added as a party appellee in No. 80-1471.
